properties.areaDesc: Saipan, MP; Tinian, MP
properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued October 27 at 8:55PM ChST until October 27 at 11:00PM ChST by NWS Tiyan GU
properties.description:
* WHAT...Urban area and small stream flooding caused by excessive
rainfall is occurring.

* WHERE...Saipan...
Tinian...

* WHEN...Until 1100 PM ChST.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Water over roadways has been reported on Saipan. Rises in small
streams.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 854 PM ChST, the public reported heavy rain in the advisory
area due to thunderstorms. This  will cause urban and small
stream flooding. Between 0.8 and 1.6 inches of rain have fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts of 0.5 to 1.5 inches are expected
over the area. This additional rain will result in minor
flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Garapan, Dandan, China Town, Tanapag, As Mahetog, Koblerville,
San Jose (Tinian Municipality), Chalan Kanoa I, San Antonio,
Chalan Kanoa II, Chalan Kanoa III, San Roque, Kagman, Chalan
Kanoa IV, Kagman III, Gualo Rai, Afetnas, Chalan Piao, Fananganan
and Chalan Laulau.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.
